paragraphs: DroneShield sells counter-drone technology, which it calls counter-UAS, to military, government, law enforcement and critical infrastructure operators around the world. The company describes a portfolio that spans RF intelligence, AI, sensor fusion and software. The stated aim is to help customers detect, understand and defeat increasingly complex drone threats. Engineering, manufacturing and support are spread across Australia, the United States and Europe.

One current product, RfRecon, runs on an AI engine called RfAI-3 and detects, classifies and geolocates AIS/ADS-B signals, unencrypted Remote ID beacons and other RF activity across the spectrum. It interoperates with ATAK-CIV, SAPIENT and third-party command-and-control platforms. Deploying several units across distributed sites yields what the company calls network-scale intelligence.
DroneShield was founded in 2014 with a single focus on countering the threat posed by drones. The company began in Virginia in the United States. DroneShield Limited is publicly listed on the ASX.
